method: Read all25 complete POS/meaning/alias/EN/ZH tuples, requested three semantic revisions, reread revised tuples and checked exact author source. Primary terminology cross-checks plus lexical review; not a claim that every cited publisher page was retrievable.

decisions.reason: Unpaid means not yet paid; does not invent a postpaid overdue deadline or imply every account is billed monthly.
Suspension identifies paused service without diagnosing nonpayment as its only cause.
A mobile-data service plan is distinct from phone storage; original example suits the noun phrase.
The allowance is used up; past-tense ran out in the example retains the same sense.
Revised definition shares a network connection without claiming all phone hotspots exclusively use cellular upstream.
Reception here is signal quality; breaking-up call demonstrates the sense rather than a reception desk.
A complete negative statement of connection failure; no inferred cause or deletion of the negative.
Network access password, not an account password; mixed-script exact aliases retain Wi-Fi subject.
A unit-dose laundry product in soluble film; no handling or treatment instructions are introduced.
A stain at the collar; example and three aliases preserve its location.
Accumulated charge and sweater crackle support the ordinary physical sense; static cling is a possible effect, not a forced synonym.
Revised definition describes the rotating dryer without unnecessarily requiring heated air; distinct from spin-dry.
Spin removes much water mechanically; aliases retain laundry context rather than mapping all dehydration to this verb.
Overlapping class times are a timetable clash; independently checked UNSW class-registration and forms terminology.
Revision now means after the deadline; removed the overbroad Chinese补交作业 alias.
Granted extension and revised deadline are preserved; does not equate any late submission with an approved extension.
Suggestions for revising written work; plural noun agrees with the original example.
Distribute group work among members; does not imply equal shares.
Agree a time for a meeting or discussion; a natural project-discussion sentence.

decisions.term: is this a good time to talk
decisions.reason: A polite complete question; does not assert availability or request a general appointment.

decisions.term: have something urgent to deal with
decisions.reason: An urgent personal matter, without automatically labelling it a life-threatening emergency.
Slight lateness of arrival is explicit; natural bus-delay reason in the original pair.
Leave ahead of others in this stated everyday context; not the head-off-prevent sense.
Then refers to the already discussed future time; confirmation example is aligned.
Alternating who pays for shared meals, distinct from splitting each individual bill.

aliasDecisions.reason: The existing reschedule verb means arrange a different time; two colloquial Chinese requests name that exact action and retain the original body.
